--aggregate-engine-logging.name: --aggregate-engine-logging
--aggregate-engine-logging.help_text: Log aggregate rather than per-engine statistics when using data parallelism.

--api-server-count.name: --api-server-count
--api-server-count.help_text: How many API server processes to run. Defaults to data_parallel_size if not specified.

--config.name: --config
--config.help_text: Read CLI options from a config file. Must be a YAML with the following options: https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/configuration/serve_args.html

--data-parallel-address.name: --data-parallel-address
--data-parallel-address.help_text: Address of data parallel cluster head-node.

--data-parallel-backend.name: --data-parallel-backend
--data-parallel-backend.help_text: Backend for data parallel, either "mp" or "ray".

--data-parallel-rank.name: --data-parallel-rank
--data-parallel-rank.help_text: Data parallel rank of this instance. When set, enables external load balancer mode.

--data-parallel-rpc-port.name: --data-parallel-rpc-port
--data-parallel-rpc-port.help_text: Port for data parallel RPC communication.

--data-parallel-size-local.name: --data-parallel-size-local
--data-parallel-size-local.help_text: Number of data parallel replicas to run on this node.

--data-parallel-start-rank.name: --data-parallel-start-rank
--data-parallel-start-rank.help_text: Starting data parallel rank for secondary nodes.

--enable-lora.name: --enable-lora
--enable-lora.help_text: If True, enable handling of LoRA adapters.

--headless.name: --headless
--headless.help_text: Run in headless mode. See multi-node data parallel documentation for more details.
